name: Fox in the Hollyhocks
source:
Altea Rosata–a city of flowers–is both parts prosperous and destitute, and this prosperity and destitution brings people in droves and waves, searching for limelight...

...or a place to hide.

[From [url=https://skyharborr.itch.io/fox-in-the-hollyhocks]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
花之城Altea Rosata既繁荣又贫困，而这种繁荣与贫困吸引着成群结队的人来到这里，寻找聚光灯……

……或是一个藏身之处。

（来源：[url=https://skyharborr.itch.io/fox-in-the-hollyhocks]itch.io[/url]）
